newsitem.title: FINLAND: Finnish Dec M2 seen down after Nov fall.
newsitem.headline: Finnish Dec M2 seen down after Nov fall.

text.p: A return to a negative Finnish M2 money supply figure in November came as no surprise and December M2 is likely to show a fall as well, analysts said on Wednesday.
The Bank of Finland said M2 fell 1.2 percent year-on-year in November having risen 0.3 percent in October after being in decline through most of 1996.
"The figure is undramatic," a central bank official said.
The M2 money aggregate comprises money in circulation, cheques, giro and transaction accounts as well as fixed-term and other bank deposits held by the public.
M2 is likely to show a bigger fall in December than in November against the background of a big flow of funds into fixed-term bank deposits in November-December 1995, the central bank official said.
